name: plan-edit-vs-template-edit-disambiguation
description: Live bug found and fixed via a prompt tightening: 'swap tomorrow's session for X' is a one-day plan change, not a permanent template edit. Permanent regression transcript - must fire week_update, never template_edit, even though a template with a similar id exists in context. G1: converted from mode=closing to mode=ordinary - C1 made plan_edit/template_edit available on every ordinary turn for a returning athlete, not just a closing one, so this disambiguation now has to hold there too. #973 later collapsed week_plan/session_reconcile/plan_edit into one week_update action - updated here to match (2026-09-13, #999 hardening round); the disambiguation this transcript exists for (a one-day swap vs a permanent template_edit) is unchanged. #807 hit this once (hardcoded date rotted past 'tomorrow', Gemini correctly declined the swap, read as a false regression) and it rotted again five weeks after that fix. OpenRouter K1 retest (2026-09-09): rather than hand-fix the date a third time, the session date is now the literal token {{TOMORROW}} - eval-coach-chat.ts's resolveRelativeDates substitutes the real UTC date one day ahead of the run at load time, every run, so this transcript can't go stale on a wall-clock basis again.
